code_only_features.feature_name: early stop on subject giving up
code_only_features.evidence: experiment_harness.py:195-200 `if self._model_is_giving_up(response.content): ... break`; _model_is_giving_up (lines 269-280) returns True if the subject's response contains phrases like 'i give up', "can't solve", 'impossible', "i'll stop", 'this cannot'. The return value is branched on and breaks the attempt loop, so the loop halts early when the subject signals inability to continue — enforced end-to-end.
